description: Michael Whatley was joined Thursday by local leaders and job creators in Gastonia to highlight Governor Cooper's failed record that resulted in everyday prices going up for North Carolina families. Whatley argued it’s easy to understand why Candidate Cooper is so upset about Governor Cooper’s policies that made North Carolina families suffer soaring healthcare costs, higher energy bills, and unaffordable housing.

title: Michael Whatley Hosts Governor Cooper Made Stuff Cost More Press Conference in Gastonia – Michael Whatley for Senate
